settings.label: Default brand context
settings.info: Sets the default brand when no page metafield is present. Individual pages override this via the brand.context metafield (cfbl / institute / musa).

settings.label: Show brand switcher in header
settings.info: Displays a compact brand navigation row (CFBL / Institute / MUSA) below the primary header. Useful on the homepage.

settings.content: Brand palettes and typography are defined by CSS custom properties in base.css. The brand_mode setting controls the default <body> class. Per-page overrides come from the brand.context page metafield.
CFBL presets — Deep Navy #2B5275, Sky Blue #4E9FBF, Sand #EED9C5. Institute presets — Forest #3D5A52, Sage #6F8F7A, Cream #EAE2D0. MUSA presets — Oxblood #6E1F23, Ochre #C5A572, Bone #F1E8D8.

settings.label: Default page background
settings.info: Overrides the brand-default background for the active brand context. Leave blank to use the brand default.

settings.label: Default body text color
settings.info: Overrides the brand-default ink color. Leave blank to use the brand default.

settings.label: Primary accent color
settings.info: Used for links, buttons, and key UI elements. CFBL default: #2B5275. Institute default: #3D5A52. MUSA default: #6E1F23.

settings.label: Base body font size (px)
settings.info: CFBL default: 17px. Institute default: 18px. MUSA default: 19px. Adjust per brand recommendation.

settings.label: Display heading weight
settings.info: Controls the font-weight applied to h1–h3 in Cormorant SC or DM Serif Display. 400–500 recommended for elegance; avoid 700 in display contexts.

settings.label: Site logo
settings.info: Recommended: SVG or PNG at 2x resolution. CFBL: use cfbl-logo-rainbow.png. Institute: use institute-logo.png. MUSA: set in MUSA brand section.

options.label: Sticky (scrolls with page, stays at top)

settings.label: Show client portal link in header
Client portal URL
settings.info: The URL for the client login / portal link. Typically a SimplePractice or similar EHR portal link.

settings.label: Newsletter signup subtext
settings.default: Essays, training announcements, and practice resources — infrequently, with intent.

settings.label: CFBL footer navigation
settings.info: Links displayed under the Center for Balanced Living column in the footer.

settings.label: Institute footer navigation
settings.info: Links displayed under the CFBL Institute column in the footer.

settings.label: MUSA footer navigation
settings.info: Links displayed under the MUSA column in the footer.

settings.label: Practice address
settings.info: Displayed in the footer contact block and used in Schema.org markup.

settings.label: Footer utility links
settings.info: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and similar bottom-row links.

settings.label: Substack URL
settings.info: Used on MUSA pages for the newsletter / essay subscription link.

settings.label: Page title suffix
settings.info: Appended to all page titles after a dash. Example: 'Delaware' produces 'Service Name — Center for Balanced Living · Delaware'. Leave blank for no suffix.

settings.label: Default social share image
settings.info: Used as the og:image fallback when a page has no specific share image. Recommended: 1200 x 630px.

settings.label: Custom CSS
settings.info: Additional CSS injected into the <head> after all theme stylesheets. Use sparingly. Brand variables are available.

settings.content: Brand CSS variables are defined in assets/base.css. To override a single brand token, use the Custom CSS field above with a .brand-cfbl, .brand-institute, or .brand-musa selector.
